questionText: What is @RequestMapping at the class level used for?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can place shared request conditions at controller level, combine them with method mappings, and identify final routes and media constraints.

claims.statement: Spring MVC combines type-level @RequestMapping conditions with method-level mappings, so a class path of /orders and method path /{id} form /orders/{id}.
Class-level consumes and produces conditions apply to mapped methods unless a method declares the same condition, in which case the method-level declaration overrides the class-level one.
A request body media type that does not satisfy consumes can produce 415, while an Accept header that cannot satisfy produces can produce 406.

examples.title: Verify combined routes plus produces and consumes failures

validation.command: Run gold.q6.ClassLevelMappingTest with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.3.1, and standalone MockMvc
validation.expected: GET /orders/42 and POST /orders succeed for JSON; unacceptable response media returns 406 and unsupported request media returns 415

notes: The table and example use the same /orders paths, so learners can derive each final route without changing domains.

review.notes: Mapping combination and media-condition rules were checked against official Spring documentation and exercised with success, 406, and 415 cases. This record is not editorially approved.
